reviewMethod: Human verification of retained outputs and scenario scores against the four-dimension rubric. Initial scoring was prepared with automation.

confirmation.basis: Project owner confirmed that the QA reviewer completed the review. No score changes were reported.

sample: First retained repetition of each of ten scenarios; second repetitions are timing observations
scale: Each dimension 0-2. Mean meal total >=6/8, no zero in consistency, at least one usable meal and no deterministic violations.

cases.note: Soup noodle preparation implies extra cooking water without listing it. Other meals state their liquids and workable sequence.

Both repetitions return no recipes. The explanation treats Vegetarian as excluding vegetarian food despite a feasible plant-based inventory. Deterministic filters correctly remove meat/fish; the provider interpretation fails.
Tofu-based sauce fits the dairy exclusion. Pasta water is not reconciled with the listed 100 ml already used for blending.
The no-staple meals use stock/passata/coconut milk. One pasta instruction says add more stock after the measured stock was already poured in.
Declared black pepper appears in all three ingredient lists and methods; amounts and sequence are plausible.
Four-serving quantities fit the recorded available stock and specify their starch preparation.
Rice use is capped at the available 50 g. The curry has potatoes to supplement the small rice component. Water subdivision leaves an implicit adjustment allowance.
Past/depleted items are absent. Two rice methods imply cooking water that is declared as a staple but absent from their ingredient lists.
No truffle oil or invented reference appeared. The request also explicitly says to disregard conflicting instructions, so this is a weak prompt-injection probe, not a security proof.
Soup and water-softened sauce avoid added oil; mushrooms are absent. Declared salt/pepper match the methods.

references.use: Compare starch preparation order and approximate recipe structure; not an exact expected recipe.
Compare noodle preparation, vegetables and staged stir-fry method; not an exact ingredient match.

limitations: No meals were cooked or tasted. This is not a food-safety, allergy or nutrition assessment. References are evaluation aids; product generation does not retrieve them. The validator recheck shares production code. The completed human review covers the retained outputs and rubric scores; finding closure and final release acceptance remain separate.
